criteria.description: Adapter-only bundles contain the declared layout, canonical CPU artifacts, checksums, base revisions, runtime support, and no resumable training state.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_17/test_bundle.py; bundle validator and fallback tensor round-trip; docs/inference/bundle_schema.json

criteria.description: Classification, segmentation, retrieval, VLM, and WSI pipelines validate task/modality and enforce bounded request contracts through the shared backend abstraction.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_17/test_inference.py; CLI smoke returned a versioned classification response; 15 Phase 17 tests passed

criteria.description: Sliding-window Gaussian reconstruction, original-coordinate restoration, NIfTI reopen checks, and derived-geometry validation are implemented.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_17/test_inference.py and test_geometry.py; NIfTI round-trip test passed in the available environment

criteria.description: DICOM SEG creation is gated by explicit reviewed highdicom policy and preserves only hashed source references in operational contracts.
Clinical-style VLM decoding is deterministic by default, research sampling is gated, structured output is validated, prompt text is isolated, and token/output limits are enforced.
criteria.evidence: tests/phase_17/test_inference.py; GenerationConfig, generate, and prompt-isolation contracts

criteria.description: The serving layer validates before adapter loading, supports requested-only bounded adapter caching, backpressure, timeouts, versioned responses, and stale-state reset.
Operational audit events record required hashes and runtime fields without raw inputs, while clinical audit data is role-gated and deletable under retention policy.
One portable bundle is empirically loaded and compared on CPU, CUDA, and TPU with warmup and stable XLA compilation counts.
criteria.justification: The acceptance environment provides CPU execution only; the bundle/runtime contracts, fixed TPU bucket policy, and warmup API are implemented, but no CUDA or TPU hardware evidence is claimed.

criteria.description: Production deployment licenses, blocked bundles, and real-checkpoint latency/memory measurements are populated.
criteria.justification: The repository contains synthetic fixtures and framework contracts rather than approved production weights or an external deployment review; docs/inference/license_catalog.md defines the fail-closed gate.
